text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... are you interested in 
ballet concerts at all?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to get some tickets 
through my dad's work, so I thought I'd 
offer if you'd like to go.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My dad's a former ballet dancer, and he's 
seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
He's my role model, my goalâ and 
someday, I want to take center stage just 
like Dad...! Or, well, that's the dream, 
anyway.
